strings.zh: 那么,{NEWLINE}请在这儿的训练师之中{CLEAR}选择您的搭档！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Please find a partner from the Trainers{NEWLINE}that are gathered here.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}还没有找到搭档！{SCROLL}要放弃寻找搭档回到接待处吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} hasn’t found a partner yet!{SCROLL}Stop looking for a partner and{NEWLINE}go back to the reception desk?

strings.zh: 寻找搭档辛苦了！{SCROLL}那么,请跟我到多人战房间来！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Thank you for choosing a partner.{SCROLL}I will now show you to your{NEWLINE}Multi Battle Room.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 彦『如果让现在的搭档使用{VAR:0106:1}{CLEAR}那就正好是对{VAR:0100:0}和{SCROLL}{VAR:0106:3}有绝对自信的{VAR:0100:2}{SCROLL}要加他为伙伴吗？
strings.en: Riley: The partners I have now?{SCROLL}Well, my {VAR:0100:0}’s nasty with its{NEWLINE}{VAR:0106:1}.{SCROLL}And there’s my {VAR:0100:2}, which{NEWLINE}is a sure hand with {VAR:0106:3}.{SCROLL}Would you like to team up with me?

strings.zh: 彦『……是吗？{NEWLINE}真遗憾。
strings.en: Riley: ...Oh, is that so?{NEWLINE}That’s too bad.

strings.zh: 彦『哈哈,谢了{NEWLINE}那么我先去等着了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Riley: Ahaha, thanks.{NEWLINE}I’ll be waiting for you.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小绿『哟,真巧啊{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}没想到你也会来战斗前线。{CLEAR}这里是双人组队的房间,{CLEAR}你要跟我一起组队挑战吗？
strings.en: Blue: Yo, what a coincidence,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}! Didn’t expect to see{CLEAR}you at the Battle Frontier.{SCROLL}This is the room for two-person teams.{NEWLINE}Want to take the challenge with me?
strings.notes: Hack replaced the vanilla partners: 小绿 Blue (was Cheryl), 小霞 Misty (was Buck), 小黄 Yellow (was Mira); 彦 Riley and 舞 Marley stay (US lines for 舞 say Marley; D-0220 lists 舞 → Mira, see question).

strings.zh: 小绿『哎？不跟我组队吗？
strings.en: Blue: Huh? You’re not{NEWLINE}teaming up with me?

strings.zh: 小绿『那么,我先走了。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Blue: Well then, I’ll go on ahead.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小霞『哈哈,这次是我先到哦。{NEWLINE}不过你应该也做好准备了吧,{CLEAR}咱们现在可以开始挑战了吗？
strings.en: Misty: Ha ha, I got here first this time.{NEWLINE}But you should be ready too, right?{CLEAR}Shall we start the challenge now?

strings.zh: 小霞『哇,什么嘛{NEWLINE}原来你是这样的家伙？
strings.en: Misty: Hey, what’s that about? So{NEWLINE}that’s the kind of person you are?

strings.zh: 小霞『嘿嘿！只要有我在{NEWLINE}什么都不成问题！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Misty: Hee hee! As long as I’m{NEWLINE}around, nothing’s a problem!!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 舞『……我的{VAR:0100:0}拿手的是{VAR:0106:1}{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:2}则喜欢{VAR:0106:3}{SCROLL}……怎么样{NEWLINE}一起去吗？
strings.en: Marley: ...My {VAR:0100:0}{NEWLINE}is good at {VAR:0106:1}.{SCROLL}{VAR:0100:2} likes {VAR:0106:3}.{SCROLL}...So... want to go together?

strings.zh: 舞『……也好吧。
strings.en: Marley: ...Whatever...

strings.zh: 舞『……那我先走了。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Marley: ...I’ll go ahead...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 小黄『{VAR:0103:0}哥哥,{NEWLINE}我做好准备了。{CLEAR}咱们一起战斗吧！
strings.en: Yellow: Big Bro {VAR:0103:0}, I’m ready.{NEWLINE}Let’s battle together!

strings.zh: 小黄『呜！{NEWLINE}你怎么可以欺负人家！
strings.en: Yellow: Waah! How could{NEWLINE}you be so mean to me?!

strings.zh: 小黄『嗯！那么我先走了{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}哥哥也快点来吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Yellow: OK! I’ll go on ahead. Hurry up{NEWLINE}and come too, Big Bro {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我要跟我的女朋友一起挑战对战塔,{NEWLINE}你如果想组队的话还是找别人吧。
strings.en: I’m taking on the Battle Tower{NEWLINE}with my girlfriend. If you want{CLEAR}a partner, find someone else.

strings.zh: 只要跟心爱的人在一起,{NEWLINE}再难的挑战也能完成。
strings.en: As long as I’m with the{NEWLINE}one I love, I can clear any{CLEAR}challenge, no matter how hard.
